panels.description: All catalog routes ranked by proven tier and Value (IQ per $ scaled by relative TPS; in-use >=100 billed reqs/7d, light/probed >0, catalog unprobed). Value measures throughput-adjusted intelligence efficiency. Projected $/M uses 7-day token mix (cached input at 10% if supported, unprobed 0.99/0.01).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  route AS "Route",
  tier_rank AS "Tier",
  value_score AS "Value",
  iq_per_dollar AS "IQ per $",
  projected_dollar_per_m AS "Projected $/M",
  ask_in AS "Ask in $/M",
  ask_out AS "Ask out $/M",
  coding_iq AS "Coding IQ",
  reqs_7d AS "Reqs (7d)",
  tokens_7d AS "Tokens (7d)",
  cache_pct AS "Cache %",
  ttft_ms AS "TTFT ms",
  tps AS "TPS",
  cost_7d AS "Cost $",
  realized_dollar_per_m AS "Realized $/M"
FROM v_model_catalog_metrics
ORDER BY "Tier" DESC, "Value" DESC NULLS LAST, "IQ per $" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Requests per model, bucket size auto-scales with the time range (short range = finer buckets). Only models in use (>=100 billed reqs in range) are shown.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', u.created_at) AS "time", u.model AS model, round(avg(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.ask_input_per_mtok, 0), rm.ask_in))::numeric, 5) AS avg_price FROM usage_logs u JOIN (SELECT model AS m2 FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100) f ON f.m2 = u.model LEFT JOIN route_metrics rm ON rm.route = u.model WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at) AND u.is_probe = false AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.ask_input_per_mtok, 0), rm.ask_in) > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', u.created_at) AS "time", u.model AS model, round(avg(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.ask_output_per_mtok, 0), rm.ask_out))::numeric, 5) AS avg_price FROM usage_logs u JOIN (SELECT model AS m2 FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100) f ON f.m2 = u.model LEFT JOIN route_metrics rm ON rm.route = u.model WHERE $__timeFilter(u.created_at) AND u.is_probe = false AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.ask_output_per_mtok, 0), rm.ask_out) > 0 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Output tokens per second by model, in-use only (>=100 billed reqs in range). Excludes TTFT/connect latency.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from u.created_at) / ($__interval_ms/500.0)) * ($__interval_ms/500.0)) AS "time", u.model AS model, round(avg(CASE WHEN duration_ms > ttft_ms + 50 AND ttft_ms > 0 AND completion_tokens > 0 AND (completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0)) <= 500 THEN completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0) END)::numeric, 1) AS avg_tps FROM usage_logs u JOIN (SELECT model AS m2 FROM usage_logs WHERE is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100) f ON f.m2 = u.model WHERE u.is_probe = false AND $__timeFilter(u.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING avg(CASE WHEN duration_ms > ttft_ms + 50 AND ttft_ms > 0 AND completion_tokens > 0 AND (completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0)) <= 500 THEN completion_tokens / ((duration_ms - ttft_ms)/1000.0) END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.description: How well the route predictor ranks and levels, at three cadences (issue #30). ORDERING (the verdict) = the crown backtest's regret share: of the transitions where the board would have crowned a route, what share realized within GATE_TOL (15%) of the cheapest. LEVEL (the diagnostic) = realized / projected ratio. The VALUE leg is the North Star metric (probe/value.py) scored on realized outcomes. DAILY is measured — each snapshot's own as-of IQ stamp, backfilled from the git-tracked data/intelligence.json history (D3): real historical values, never interpolated. The HOURLY legs read 'n/a' by design, NOT as a failure: the hourly series is rebuilt from usage_logs and carries no D3 iq stamp, and IQ's own resolution is a day, so there is no as-of IQ to read at an hourly boundary. The daily leg is the leg that can be scored.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  cadence AS "Cadence",
  transitions AS "Transitions",
  cost_n AS "Cost n",
  cost_land AS "Cost land",
  cost_share AS "Cost share",
  CASE WHEN cost_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Cost verdict",
  value_n AS "Value n",
  value_land AS "Value land",
  value_share AS "Value share",
  CASE WHEN value_status = 'measured'
       THEN CASE WHEN value_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END
       ELSE 'n/a - ' || COALESCE(value_limit, 'unresolved')
  END AS "Value verdict",
  level_n AS "Level n",
  level_median AS "Level median",
  level_within_50pct AS "Level within 50pct",
  level_within_2x AS "Level within 2x",
  computed_at AS "Computed"
FROM predictor_scoreboard
ORDER BY CASE cadence
  WHEN 'daily' THEN 0 WHEN 'hourly_cumulative' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

panels.title: Predictor scoreboard — ordering accuracy (verdict) + level ratio (diagnostic)

panels.description: The projection gate, BOTH legs (issue #35, item 2 of the 2026-09-12 owner decision set). The gate's question is unchanged: of the transitions where the board would have crowned a route (lowest projected $/M), what share realized within GATE_TOL (15%) of the cheapest realized route. What item 2 moved is the METRIC the regret ratio is taken on. COST takes it on realized $/M; VALUE takes it on the North Star metric (probe/value.py), on both sides of the ratio, never mixed. The same GATE_TOL / GATE_SHARE / GATE_MIN_N apply to both - a pass/fail constant is owner property and is never re-tuned to make a leg pass. IMPORTANT: the GATE's verdict is the VALUE leg (owner ruling 2026-09-12: "4. Value.") - the 'Gate verdict' column reads projection_gate.pass and the 'Value verdict' column reads value_pass, which by that ruling are the same verdict shown twice. The cost leg's own verdict is RETAINED as cost_pass and is what the 'Cost verdict' column now reads; it no longer drives the panels' projected-basis switch. A 'n/a - unresolved' Value verdict is a RESOLUTION limit of the input (no as-of IQ stamp on the snapshot), never evidence that Value failed - but it does leave the gate's verdict false, because nothing was measured and nothing is certified.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Gate verdict",
  CASE WHEN cost_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END AS "Cost verdict",
  n AS "Cost n",
  land AS "Cost land",
  share AS "Cost share",
  CASE WHEN value_status = 'measured'
       THEN CASE WHEN value_pass THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'FAIL' END
       ELSE 'n/a - ' || COALESCE(value_status, 'unresolved')
  END AS "Value verdict",
  value_n AS "Value n",
  value_land AS "Value land",
  value_share AS "Value share",
  value_status AS "Value status",
  computed_at AS "Computed"
FROM projection_gate
WHERE id = 'projection_gate'

panels.title: Projection gate — gate verdict (Value) + retained cost verdict
